entries.authority: GitHub remains authoritative for repository and review state.
Gmail remains authoritative for mailbox messages; public archive must not store private message/thread IDs or raw email.

entries.scope: Public item metadata and approved preservation packages
entries.authority: Internet Archive remains authoritative for its item metadata and task state.

entries.scope: CrossRef, Semantic Scholar, arXiv, PubMed, OpenAlex and related scholarly metadata
entries.authority: Publisher, DOI registration agency and repository records remain authoritative for bibliographic and version facts.
Each repository owns its files, contracts and release history.

entries.scope: Engineering, computer science, mathematics, data, security and technology concept pages
entries.authority: Wikipedia revision history and cited primary sources; article content is secondary reference material.
entries.policy: Store page title, page ID, revision ID, revision timestamp, canonical URL, categories and cited sources; do not treat page text as primary proof.

entries.scope: Public GitHub/GitLab repositories selected for engineering research
entries.authority: Underlying source repository and commit are authoritative; DeepWiki explanations are derived and must be corroborated against code.
entries.policy: Capture repository URL, indexed commit/time where exposed, DeepWiki page URL, cited source files and exact commit links; label generated explanations INFERENCE until verified.

entries.scope: Computer science and engineering categories including cs.SE, cs.DC, cs.DB, cs.IR, cs.AI, cs.CL, cs.CR, cs.NI, cs.SY and eess
entries.authority: arXiv record and version history; publisher/DOI registries for publication metadata.
entries.policy: Preserve arXiv ID and version separately; distinguish preprint, accepted manuscript and published version; verify DOI and retraction status where possible.

entries.authority: Upstream source repository, pinned commit, tests and documentation.
entries.policy: Treat generated wiki content as navigation aid; independently inspect source files and run tests.

entries.scope: User-mentioned FOSS, developer tools, infrastructure and engineering documentation
entries.authority: Upstream project repositories, release registries and official documentation.
entries.policy: Capture license, maintenance/release cadence, supported versions, security advisories, provenance and dependency metadata before adoption.

inventory_rules: Do not infer connected status from a URL alone.
Record connector scopes and last successful observation.
Never store credential values or secret-bearing environment output.
Every new source requires owner, purpose, permitted operations, data classes, jurisdiction, retention and offboarding plan.
A source can be catalogued even when disconnected; mark its observation and connector state accurately.
